title: Napoleon Wasn't Actually Short
description: The idea that Napoleon was tiny is a myth that came from a measurement mix up and wartime cartoons.

scenes.text: Napoleon is famous for being short. But he probably wasn't.
scenes.subject: napoleon
scenes.say: Napoleon is famous for being short. [chuckles] But he probably wasn't.

scenes.text: Most historians think he was around one point seven meters tall, roughly average for a Frenchman of his time.
scenes.subject: napoleon
scenes.say: Most historians think he was around one point seven meters tall, roughly average for a Frenchman of his time.

scenes.text: Part of the confusion came from measurements. French inches were longer than British inches, so his height sounded smaller than it was.
scenes.say: [curious] Part of the confusion came from measurements. French inches were longer than British inches, so his height sounded smaller than it was.

scenes.text: British cartoonists also loved drawing him as a tiny, angry man, and the image stuck.
scenes.subject: napoleon
scenes.say: [laughs] British cartoonists also loved drawing him as a tiny, ANGRY man, and the image stuck.

scenes.text: Sometimes history remembers the joke, not the truth. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: napoleon
scenes.say: [sighs] Sometimes history remembers the joke, not the truth. Follow for more weird facts.
